description: The plot illustrates average performance (in percent) for three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—measured across increasing model sizes. The x-axis is labeled with model size categories on a linear categorical scale, ranging from 70m through 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, to 7.0B (ticks shown at each category). The y-axis is labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0 to 80 with major tick labels at 20-unit intervals (20, 40, 60, 80). The Precision series is a red solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting near 79% at 70m, decreasing to about 76% at 160m and about 71% at 410m, then rising gradually through about 72–73% at 1.0B–1.4B, about 74% at 2.8B, and ending near 77–78% at 7.0B. The Recall series is a blue solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, increasing steadily from about 8% at 70m to about 11% at 160m, about 20% at 410m, about 26% at 1.0B, about 28% at 1.4B, about 35% at 2.8B, and about 45% at 7.0B. The F1-score series is a purple solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, rising from about 14% at 70m to about 19% at 160m, about 31% at 410m, about 39% at 1.0B, about 41% at 1.4B, about 48% at 2.8B, and about 56% at 7.0B.
